arxiv-2005-12691.title: First principles determination of some static and dynamic properties of the liquid 3 d d transition metals near melting
arxiv-2005-12691.creator: B.G. del Rio, C. Pascual, O. Rodriguez, L.E. González, D.J. González
arxiv-2005-12691.description: Abstract We report an ab initio molecular dynamics simulation study of several static and dynamic properties of the liquid 3 d transition metals. The calculated static structure factors show qualitative agreement with the available experimental data, and its second peak displays an asymmetric shape which suggests a significant local icosahedral short-range order.

arxiv-2311-05754.title: Deep Natural Language Feature Learning for Interpretable Prediction
arxiv-2311-05754.creator: Felipe Urrutia 1, 2], Cristian Buc 1, Valentin Barriere 1, 2]
arxiv-2311-05754.description: Abstract We propose a general method to break down a main complex task into a set of intermediary easier sub-tasks, which are formulated in natural language as binary questions related to the final target task. Our method allows for representing each example by a vector consisting of the answers to these questions.

arxiv-2405-18091.title: An adaptive transfer learning perspective on classification in non-stationary environments
arxiv-2405-18091.creator: Henry W J Reeve
arxiv-2405-18091.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Henry W J Reeve. We consider a semi-supervised classification problem with non-stationary label-shift in which we observe a labelled data set followed by a sequence of unlabelled covariate vectors in which the marginal probabilities of the class labels may change over time. Our objective is to predict the corresponding class-label for each covariate vector, without ever observing the ground-truth labels, beyond the initial labelled data set.

arxiv-2411-16771.title: VidHal : Benchmarking Temporal Hallucinations in Vision LLMs
arxiv-2411-16771.creator: Wey Yeh Choong c.weyyeh@u.nus.edu, Yangyang Guo guoyang.eric@gmail.com, Mohan Kankanhalli mohan@comp.nus.edu.sg
arxiv-2411-16771.description: Abstract Vision Large Language Models (VLLMs) are widely acknowledged to be prone to hallucinations. Existing research addressing this problem has primarily been confined to image inputs, with sparse exploration of their video-based counterparts. Furthermore, current evaluation methods fail to capture nuanced errors in generated responses, which are often exacerbated by the rich spatiotemporal dynamics of videos.

arxiv-2501-13240.title: Deciphering boundary layer dynamics in high-Rayleigh-number convection using 3360 GPUs and a high-scaling in-situ workflow
arxiv-2501-13240.creator: Mathis Bode, Damian Alvarez, Paul Fischer, Christos E. Frouzakis, Jens Henrik Göbbert, Joseph A. Insley, Yu-Hsiang Lan, Victor A. Mateevitsi, Misun Min, Michael E. Papka, Silvio Rizzi, Roshan J. Samuel, Jörg Schumacher
arxiv-2501-13240.description: Abstract Turbulent heat and momentum transfer processes due to thermal convection cover many scales and are of great importance for several natural and technical flows. One consequence is that a fully resolved three-dimensional analysis of these turbulent transfers at high Rayleigh numbers, which includes the boundary layers, is possible only using supercomputers.

arxiv-2510-04682.title: TiTok: Transfer Token-level Knowledge via Contrastive Excess to Transplant LoRA
arxiv-2510-04682.creator: Chanjoo Jung, Jaehyung Kim
arxiv-2510-04682.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely applied in real world scenarios, but fine-tuning them comes with significant computational and storage costs. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods such as LoRA mitigate these costs, but the adapted parameters are dependent on the base model and cannot be transferred across different backbones.

arxiv-2510-24086.title: Single impurity atom embedded in a dipolar two-soliton molecule as a qubit
arxiv-2510-24086.creator: S. M. Al-Marzoug 1 , B. B. Baizakov 2 , U. Al Khawaja 3 and H. Bahlouli 4
arxiv-2510-24086.description: Abstract We consider a single impurity atom trapped in a double well (DW) potential created by a dipolar two-soliton molecule in a quasi-one-dimensional geometry. By solving the eigenvalue problem for the impurity atom in the DW potential, we find that its ground and first excited states are well separated from higher excited states.

pmc-10745549.title: Breath Analysis for Lung Cancer Early Detection—A Clinical Study
pmc-10745549.creator: Zhunan Jia, Velmurugan Thavasi, Thirumalai Venkatesan, Pyng Lee, Daniel Raftery
pmc-10745549.description: This clinical study presents a comprehensive investigation into the utility of breath analysis as a non-invasive method for the early detection of lung cancer. The study enrolled 14 lung cancer patients, 14 non-lung cancer controls with diverse medical conditions, and 3 tuberculosis (TB) patients for biomarker discovery.

pmc-11470628.title: Effectiveness of the active communication education program in improving the general quality of life of older adults who use hearing aids: a randomized clinical trial
pmc-11470628.creator: Anthony Marcotti, Sebastián Rivera, Catherine Silva-Letelier, Javier Galaz-Mella, Eduardo Fuentes-López
pmc-11470628.description: BackgroundHearing loss in older adults affects general, generic health-related and disease-specific quality of life (QoL). The conventional strategy to address it is through hearing aids, which have been shown to improve disease-specific QoL. However, the long-term results regarding general quality of life are unknown, and communication problems and stigma associated with hearing loss may persist.

pmc-11662917.title: Visual, Refractive, Functional, and Patient Satisfaction Outcomes After Implantation of a New Extended Depth-of-Focus Intraocular Lens
pmc-11662917.creator: Javier Ferrando Gil, Adela Churruca Irazola, Iraia Reparaz, Gorka Lauzirika, Itziar Martínez-Soroa, Javier Mendicute
pmc-11662917.description: PurposeTo describe the visual, refractive, functional, and patient satisfaction outcomes of the Bi-Flex POB-MA 877PEY (Elon®, Medicontur Medical Engineering Ltd. Zsámbék, Hungary) extended depth-of-focus intraocular lens (EDoF IOL).Patients and MethodsThis was a prospective longitudinal descriptive study. Patients who underwent cataract surgery with the implantation of Bi-Flex POB-MA 877PEY IOL were included.

pmc-12649629.title: Two Sides of the Same Quip: Humor Appeals Can Indirectly Reduce Reactance via Perceived Humor but Simultaneously Increase Reactance Independently of Perceived Humor
pmc-12649629.creator: Adam S Richards, Nicholas S Curcio, Sydney G Hall, John A Banas
pmc-12649629.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study assessed whether a humor appeal can reduce the degree to which freedom threatening language elicits psychological reactance and subsequently reduces positive vaccination attitude. A 2 (freedom threatening language: low vs. high) × 2 (humor appeal: absent vs. present) between-subjects experiment was conducted during the COVID-19 pandemic in the context of social media posts about vaccination using a sample of people eligible for vaccination (N = 190).

pmc-12812915.title: Reflections of digital slavery in physical inactivity: examining gender-based physical activity attitudes and smartphone addiction among university students
pmc-12812915.creator: Unsal Altinisik, Hasan Guler, Ozkan Isik, Laurentiu-Gabriel Talaghir, Liliana Nanu, Paula Ivan
pmc-12812915.description: PurposeThe purpose of this study was to examine the gender-based physical activity attitudes of university students according to their smartphone addiction levels.MethodsThe study was designed using a relational screening model. One thousand twenty-one university students participated in the study voluntarily and data were collected using an online survey method.

pmc-12986243.title: Mechanical Performance and Microstructure Evolution of High-Ferrite Portland Cement Concrete Under the Coupled Abrasion and Freeze–Thaw Cycling Conditions
pmc-12986243.creator: Xingdong Lv, Yun Dong, Zeyu Fan
pmc-12986243.description: This study investigates the performance and microstructure evolution of high-ferrite Portland cement (HFC) concrete under the coupled action of abrasion and freeze–thaw cycles (CAA-FTC). The 3D surface morphology of deteriorated concrete was studied; abrasion depth and volume loss evolution data were collected, while analyzing the abrasion depth fractal dimension.

pmc-13088702.title: Laparoscopic adhesiolysis for adhesion-related chronic abdominal and pelvic pain after gynaecological and general surgery: an updated meta-analysis and systematic review
pmc-13088702.creator: Mengdie Wang, Xin Guo, Yan Guo, Shiqin Lu, Rui Zhang, Xuesong Chen, Xiaorong Liu, Yali Zhou, Meixian Hu, Zhimei Xu, Guozhong Zhou, Yinghui Yu
pmc-13088702.description: BackgroundChronic pain resulting from postoperative adhesions represents a significant clinical concern due to its substantial impact on patient quality of life; however, optimal therapeutic management remains contentious. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the efficacy of laparoscopic adhesiolysis in alleviating chronic pain attributable to postoperative adhesions, and to assess the influence of adhesion barriers on treatment outcomes.

pmc-13373451.title: Enhanced Endogenous GABA Biosynthesis Modifies Fruit Production and GABA Accumulation in a Medium‐Sized Tomato Cultivar Under Salt Stress
pmc-13373451.creator: Toon Suzuki, Mariko Takayama, Hiroshi Ezura
pmc-13373451.description: While exogenous γ‐aminobutyric acid (GABA) enhances plant stress tolerance, fruit responses to increased endogenous GABA biosynthesis remain unclear. Although high‐GABA traits mitigate productivity loss in cherry tomatoes under salt stress, salinity responses differ among cultivars, and whether this occurs in medium‐sized tomatoes remains unknown.

pmc-13414365.creator: Yves Janssens, Erwin Berenschot, Minh Nguyen, Niels Tas

pmc-13439131.title: Synonymous mutations in essential genes infrequently produce fitness effects in human cell lines
pmc-13439131.creator: Yiyun Rao, Ivan Sokirniy, Edward O’Brien, Justin Pritchard
pmc-13439131.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The assumption that synonymous mutations are fitness-neutral is central to many foundational results in the fields of genetics, genomics, evolutionary biology, and medicine. However, recent results suggest synonymous mutations have pervasive and strong fitness effects. These vigorously debated studies in non-human model systems have even suggested that the proportion of synonymous mutations and their fitness effect sizes are similar to non-synonymous mutations.

pmc-13549368.title: Toward functional integration of 3D‐printed meniscal scaffolds: A materials‐driven systematic review of preclinical evidence and translational framework
pmc-13549368.creator: Andrea Ferrero, Giuseppe Anzillotti, Pietro Conte, Simonetta Resta, Simone Micalizzi, Cecilia Cappelli, Nada Mansour, Paolo Oliva, Elizaveta Kon, Daniele D'Arrigo
pmc-13549368.description: PurposeMeniscal injuries are among the most common knee disorders and a major risk factor for osteoarthritis. Although meniscectomy provides short‐term symptom relief, it irreversibly alters joint biomechanics, underscoring the need for regenerative strategies. Advances in additive manufacturing and biomaterials science have enabled three‐dimensional (3D)‐printed meniscal scaffolds with controlled architecture, tunable anisotropy and tailored biological functionality.
